Rules / Tool

SK9014 The repository carries no canonical block

There is no .editorconfig, or there is one with no # skala:canonical begin / end markers, so drift from the canonical cannot be detected. Info, never a failure. skala config sync --apply adopts it: the canonical goes on top and everything already in the file is preserved verbatim below # skala:local begin.

CategoryTool

Since0.6

Why

A repository that has not opted in must not be failed by a command it did not ask for — skala config diff --canonical on Skala's own repository exits 0 with UNMANAGED, and a test pins that. Adoption is non-destructive by construction: existing sections move under the local marker, where later sections win, and a stray preamble root = true is folded into the canonical block and named in the applied list.

When it does not fire

The markers are matched case-sensitively at the start of a trimmed line, so a hand-retyped marker reads as unmanaged rather than as SK9008 drift. Unmanaged excludes both drift and SK9009, and co-occurs with SK9013 and SK9016, which are computed against the whole file. Without --apply, sync prints what it would do and writes nothing.
